The Sales Associate is responsible for providing all Marine Corps Exchange (MCX) customers with world class customer service with an additional emphasis on courtesy.

Sales associates are the primary service providers and will assist customers in every aspect of the retail business in a friendly, professional, and proactive manner that supports continued customer loyalty.

Sales associates assist their customers in challenging scenarios by using an ¿I can do that¿ mindset, to make all attempts for a positive customer experience and outcomes, before asking for support from the next level mentor or supervisor.

Sales associates are brand and customer program ambassadors for all Marine Corps and MCX programs, including but not limited to, Military Star, Super Star Student, customer satisfaction surveys and Keep it New.

This position can be scheduled throughout the facility, based on the needs of the business including but not limited to, cashier or self-checkout attendant, customer service, salesfloor / department support, stockroom / backroom, and military clothing.

In addition to working indoors, associates may be required to work outdoors or inside coolers and/or chillers. Limited time durations and proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided when working inside coolers and/or chillers.

Sales associates who are regularly scheduled in areas are expected to learn basic product knowledge to support customer satisfaction and service.

Sales associates perform store operations tasks such as but not limited to, customer and register transactions, Planogram revisions and setups, identifying missing products, replenish sales floor and coolers, setting promotional signage, visual merchandising, maintaining backroom standards through the 5S program and other operational tasks.

Light housekeeping tasks such as but not limited to sweeping, dusting and trash removal may be part of daily assigned duties. Sales associates are supported by the Specialist role with mentoring, guidance, and training. Sales associates are expected to work with, learn from and request guidance from Specialists in addition to their supervisors.

Sales associates utilize and complete tasks with basic retail equipment including, but not limited to, cash registers, time clocks, RF scanners, mobile printers, handheld equipment (i.e., Price labeling units, box cutters), signage equipment and basic fixture equipment such as, but not limited to peg hooks, shelves, and mobile stocking carts (5S Program).

Assists in preparing and participates in year-end inventory and preparation. Identifies and communicates potential risk of loss and/or theft. Sales associates market and train self-checkout to shoppers.

Maintain self-checkout units to include cleaning the units input and output belts, scanner glass, terminal display, magnetic card reader heads, and shutting down and rebooting as needed. Replace consumable supplies as needed. Charge mobile devices and device batteries as needed.

Sales associates understand how to perform functions from each of the following Self-Checkout application states: Shopping Mode, Store Mode, Assist Mode, Supervisor Mode, and Training Mode. Successfully interpret lane status indicators and clear all events identified by lane signals and lane status indicators.

May require additional training or certifications as required by the business and/or normal working assignments, including but not limited to, food safety training and fuel. Articulates MCX value stories and engages with all team members through positive conversations and driving customer satisfaction in a teams win environment.

Adheres to safety regulations and standards. Adheres to established standards of the EEO program and prevention of sexual harassment. Performs other duties as assigned. This is a mixed position where the associate must be able to lift and carry objects up to 45 lbs. independently and objects over 45 lbs. with assistance.
Minimum of 1-year experience working in a customer and sales-focused environment is preferred. Cash handling, basic math and register experience strongly preferred. Ability to read and understand operating standards and procedures for service, service recovery, sales and store brand and work within the position to execute these standards properly. Ability to work in a high-performance atmosphere with commitment to service and sales goals. Attention to detail is required.

Smartling is seeking a French-speaking Business Development Representative for a remote, work-from-home position based in Ireland. Smartling’s Business Development team is a group of highly motivated sales professionals whose focus is to source and engage with high-potential prospects.

As the first point of contact with potential customers, you will qualify active buying interest and be a critical part of the bridge between marketing and sales to ensure new customer acquisition is consistent, high-quality, and frictionless.
Smartling is an AI-native translation platform that's redefining how the world's biggest brands go global — ranked #3 on Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies list . We're growing rapidly at scale and are backed by Battery Ventures, a global technology-focused investment firm. While most companies are still figuring out how to use AI, we've spent years building it into the core of our platform — and we're just getting started.
What’s in it for you
Become a business representative via regular and structured coaching and training
Be a part of an ambitious and highly motivated team
You will learn vital prospecting skills and be a champion in discovery calls with prospects
Develop your core foundation and launch your career as a SaaS sales professional
Work in a fast-paced technology company
Sales performance incentives for fun (SPIFFs!)
You Will
Work alongside marketing and sales to source and engage with high-potential prospects and companies
Develop and execute outreach strategies via email, Zoom and social channels
Generate curiosity with potential customers by clearly articulating Smartling’s value proposition
Act as a consultative partner for potential customers; fielding questions and handling objections
Once prospects have been qualified and a fit has been identified, execute a hand-off to Account Executives
Diligently record and manage prospect and company information in Salesforce.com
Become a Smartling expert, maintaining an in-depth knowledge of the product, competitive positioning and industry trends
Be a Smartling ambassador at industry events and conferences
You Have
Proficiency in French
Interest in sales as a career
Track record of top performance in a competitive environment
A natural passion and curiosity for fast-paced technology
Clear communicator with a deep sense of empathy
A self-starter who loves problem-solving and teamwork
Excellent written communication skills
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
1 year customer-facing experience
A home office setup conducive for working remotely, and the ability to work effectively as a remote team member*

Working knowledge of sales and marketing tools, e.g. Salesforce.com, LinkedIn, Outreach
Prior experience within a fast-paced technology company
You Are
Results-focused. Motivated, hard-working and ready to level up to your career goals
Curious: You’re a “forever learner” with an insatiable desire to gain new skills and knowledge
Enthusiastic . A fun and energetic co-worker
Customer-focused. Passionate for client success at all times
Detail-oriented . Have excellent time management and organisational skills
A team-player . Who gets excited by a fast-paced, high-energy environment
You Will Enjoy
Freedom - we are remote-first
Growth - an opportunity to learn and advance your career

Balance - flexible PTO
Culture - an energetic, value-driven, and fun culture and team spirit
Bonus - employee referral programs and Apple equipment
Smartling is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, skills, and experiences.

Job Description: Providing for loved ones, planning rewarding retirements, saving enough for whatever lies ahead – our policyholders count on us to be there when it matters most. It’s a big ask, but it’s one that we have the power to deliver when we work together.

We collaborate and innovate – pushing one another to transform not just Pacific Life , but the entire industry for the better. Why? Because it’s the right thing to do. Pacific Life is more than a job, it’s a career with purpose.

It’s a career where you have the support, balance, and resources to make a positive impact on the future – including your own. Pacific Life is seeking a skilled sales professional to support the growth of Broker Distribution within the Workforce Benefits organization.

You will play an integral part in Pacific Life ’s efforts to establish and grow a $1B revenue, profitable business in the Workforce Benefits market. This role is considered to be 100% remote, as travel is required, and our ideal candidate for this role will be based in the Maryland or DC marketplace .

As Workforce Benefits Sales Consultant - Broker Distribution you’ll play a key role in the startup and long-term success of this business by working with leaders in the Workforce Benefits division to meet established goals and objectives.

Your focus will be on building relationships, developing and executing broker specific strategies and driving growth toward sales goals within the Broker Distribution Channel. You are responsible for bringing our business to the broker market and meeting annual metrics-based sales objectives.

The role will align with other Workforce Benefits Distribution resources to educate the Broker and GA marketplace around Pacific Life ’s Group Benefits value proposition and meet collective sales goals. You will report directly to the RSM of Broker Distribution.

How You'll Help Move Us Forward Support the creation and execution of a strategy for Broker Distribution that helps meet new sales, retention, profitability and expense objectives. Meet annual sales goals as established by the RSM of Broker Distribution.

Partner with Workforce Benefits Distribution resources to deliver the Workforce Benefits story to the broker community. Continually work to strengthen, deepen, and grow broker relationships. Execute appropriate number of broker meetings per week with assigned brokers. Drive a pipeline of appropriate number of RFP’s per month.

Build and advance local broker relationships to drive sales and increase the Pacific Life brand in your market. Demonstrate proficiency in the group products sold by Pacific Life .

Maintain strong connections with underwriting, product, pricing, regulatory compliance, and actuarial pricing teams to ensure alignment on critical deliverables with your broker relationships. Utilize established and innovative approaches, tools and partners to enable efficient, deliberate and robust growth objectives.

Bring a customer-first mindset: prioritize customer and broker viewpoints in decision-making. Participate in ongoing industry and community activities to stay attuned to industry trends. Represent the company as needed with legislative platforms, industry events, community activities. Perform other job-related duties or special projects as required.

The Experience You Bring 5+ years’ experience in group benefits sales with an established presence in the broker marketplace College degree with concentration in business management, finance, or risk management or equivalent work experience is required.

The inclination to seek and analyze data from a variety of sources to support decisions and to align others with the organization's overall strategy. An entrepreneurial and creative approach to developing new, innovative ideas that will stretch the organization and push the boundaries within the industry.

Ability to seek opinions of others, process feedback and take smart risks. A high degree of integrity and able to act in a transparent and consistent manner while always taking into account what is best for the organization.

Self-reflective and aware of his/her own limitations; leads by example and drives the organization's performance with an attitude of continuous improvement. Mindset to enable breakthrough innovations and business models that create value for all stakeholders, continually challenging traditional approaches.

What Makes You Stand Out Strong performance orientation and drive for results. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to grasp complexities and perceive relationships among business and financial issues. Known for ability to respectfully and confidently collaborate and easily communicate with various stakeholders.

Compensation: The base salary for this position is $75,000. In addition, this role is eligible for incentives based on sales performance. You can be who you are. We are committed to a culture of diversity and inclusion that embraces the authenticity of all employees, partners and communities.

We support all employees to thrive and achieve their fullest potential. What’s life like at Pacific Life ? Visit Instagram.com/lifeatpacificlife Base Pay Range: The base pay range noted represents the company’s good faith minimum and maximum range for this role at the time of posting.

The actual compensation offered to a candidate will be dependent upon several factors, including but not limited to experience, qualifications and geographic location. Also, most employees are eligible for additional incentive pay.

Your Benefits Start Day 1 Your wellbeing is important to Pacific Life , and we’re committed to providing you with flexible benefits that you can tailor to meet your needs. Whether you are focusing on your physical, financial, emotional, or social wellbeing, we’ve got you covered.

Prioritization of your health and well-being including Medical, Dental, Vision, and Wellbeing Reimbursement Account that can be used on yourself or your eligible dependents Generous paid time off options including: Paid Time Off, Holiday Schedules, and Financial Planning Time Off Paid Parental Leave as well as an Adoption Assistance Program Competitive 401k savings plan with company match and an additional contribution regardless of participation You Can Be Who You Are We are committed to a culture of diversity and inclusion that embraces the authenticity of all employees, partners and communities.

We support all employees to thrive and achieve their fullest potential. What’s life like at Pacific Life ? Visit Instagram.com/lifeatpacificlife EEO Statement: Pacific Life Insurance Company is an Equal Opportunity /Affirmative Action Employer, M/F/D/V.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request an accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our career center as a result of your disability. To request an accommodation, contact a Human Resources Representative at Pacific Life Insurance Company.

The ideal candidate is proactive, persuasive, and comfortable selling into mid-market and enterprise-level organizations.

Conduct outbound prospecting to generate new business opportunities in environmental services.
Identify and engage decision-makers in operations, facilities, sustainability, and procurement roles.
Educate prospects on environmental compliance, waste reduction, and sustainability solutions.

Use cold calling, email outreach, and LinkedIn to build pipeline.

Research target industries such as manufacturing, retail, logistics, and corporate enterprises.
Consistently meet or exceed KPIs related to outreach, lead conversion, and meetings booked.

Strong outbound prospecting experience (cold calling, email, LinkedIn outreach).
Excellent communication and objection-handling skills.
Experience using CRM systems such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar.

You have real sales skills and know how to close. This is a closing seat, and closing ability is the number one thing.
You have inside sales, phone sales, or SDR experience, with a real track record on the phone.
You handle objections on your own and ask for the sale, without sounding pushy or robotic.
You stay calm under pressure: when a customer pushes back or gets frustrated, you hear them out and respond thoughtfully instead of getting flustered or talking over them.
You communicate in confident, professional English at C2 level with a low accent, and sound natural on the phone.
You respond and follow through without anyone watching.
You keep the CRM clean and never let a follow-up slip.
You are the voice that turns warm customers into booked jobs. The demand is already there: customers call, the field team visits, and revenue gets left on the table when nobody follows up to close. This is not a cold-sales grind. You work from proven scripts, but you make them your own and sound human rather than robotic. You win the deal by handling objections live and guiding customers to yes.

Call customers and close deals, whether the opportunity is a service job or a larger project.
Handle objections live on the call and guide the customer to a yes rather than reading from a script.
Take the company's scripts, learn from them, and make them sound natural, never robotic.
Follow up with customers after each visit, capture honest feedback, and turn warm conversations into booked work.
Update the CRM (ServiceTitan) in real time with accurate records on every contact.

Experience in plumbing or construction, or a track record closing service and installation projects.
Formal sales training or coaching, with frameworks for discovery and closing.
Hands-on experience with ServiceTitan or a similar CRM.
Previous experience in a high-volume, phone-based, customer-facing role.
What success looks like
First 90 days: you are contacting customers and closing deals, ramped on scripts, and maintaining clean CRM hygiene.
Ongoing: you sustain a strong close rate month over month, meet conversion targets, and proactively surface and fix friction in the sales process.
Here is what to expect after you apply
You will get an email from Puente with a short online assessment and a quick grammar check.
You will record three short video answers so we can see how you communicate.
If it looks like a fit, our recruiter sets up an interview.
Shortlisted candidates are introduced to the US client team for final interviews.
This is a full-time independent contractor role, Monday to Friday 9 AM - 6 PM CT, 100% remote. Compensation ranges from $2,000 to $3,500 USD per month based on experience and performance. You will receive a company laptop and headset, flexible break scheduling, and clear monthly conversion targets that feed into performance bonuses.

Sales Development Representative Location: Remote (required to live in one of the following states: AZ, CO, FL, GA, IL, MI, MN, NY, NC, TX, UT,VT) Qualifications:
1+ year of dedicated experience in an Outbound Sales Development or Business Development Representative role , with a proven track record of successful cold outreach (cold calling, email, LinkedIn).
Demonstrated ability to identify target prospects and key decision-makers within a given territory.
Experience conducting high-volume, consistent outbound activities while maintaining quality and personalization.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate value propositions clearly and handle objections effectively.
A results-oriented mindset with a strong drive to meet and exceed targets.
Familiarity with CRM software (preferably Salesforce) and sales engagement tools (e.g., Outreach, SalesLoft).
Ability to work collaboratively with Account Executives and adapt to evolving sales strategies.
Resilience and a positive attitude in the face of challenges, with a strong desire to learn and grow in a sales career.
Fintech, SaaS, or startup experience is a plus, demonstrating an ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Experience in the payments or SMB market.
Familiarity with sales methodologies.
Proven ability to leverage data to improve prospecting effectiveness.

s.h: A day in the life and how you’ll make an impact
s.t:
Execute Strategic Cold Outreach: Conduct high-volume, targeted outbound activities including cold calls, personalized emails, and LinkedIn outreach to engage prospects who are not yet familiar with Melio .

We bring together thousands of executives, investors, founders and industry leaders at our conferences around the world, creating opportunities for people to learn, connect and build meaningful business relationships.

You will play a key role in helping us build some of the world's leading business conferences by bringing the right people into the room.
We will give you the training, tools and responsibility to succeed while continuously challenging you to develop your commercial skills and accelerate your career.
You’ll be based out of our HQ in London, where you will work alongside an ambitious and entrepreneurial team.
Uncapped earning potential: A competitive base salary and attractive commission structure where your results directly impact your earnings.
Rapid development: An opportunity to build exceptional sales skills in a high-performance environment with continuous coaching and feedback.
International exposure: Speak every day with senior executives, investors and business leaders from companies around the world.
International travel: The opportunity to attend our conferences and see first-hand the events and communities you help build.
Unlimited growth potential: We strongly believe in promoting internally and have a track record of giving exceptional performers significant responsibility early in their careers.

Your mission will be to drive revenue by selling delegate passes to senior professionals attending United Media's international conferences.
Your responsibilities will vary; however, some of them will be to:
Drive new business revenue: Proactively reach out to prospective delegates and convert them into paying attendees across our portfolio of conferences.
Own your sales targets: Take responsibility for ambitious monthly revenue targets and consistently work towards exceeding them.
Execute high-volume outreach: Work within a fast-paced outbound sales environment, making 60+ calls per day and creating approximately 10 qualified sales opportunities or proposals.
Own your pipeline: Manage prospects from first conversation through follow-up, proposal and close, ensuring opportunities continue to move forward.
Become an expert: Develop a strong understanding of our conferences, audiences and industries so you can confidently communicate why the right people should be in the room.
Collaborate across teams: Work closely with our marketing, content and conference teams to continuously improve our campaigns and the experience we offer delegates.
What we expect from you
You have a strong work ethic, a high sense of urgency and a genuine desire to succeed. You enjoy competing against ambitious targets, take ownership of your results and are motivated by seeing your own performance improve.
Most importantly, you want to sell . You enjoy the chase, the conversation and the feeling of turning an opportunity into a closed deal.
Drive & ambition: You are highly motivated, competitive and want to be exceptional at what you do.
Commercial mindset: You are excited by targets, revenue and the opportunity to directly influence your earnings through your performance.
Resilience: You are comfortable with a high level of outbound activity and have the persistence to keep going when you hear "no".
Communication: You are confident speaking with new people and can communicate professionally and persuasively over the phone and in writing.
Relationship building: You are genuinely curious about people and able to build rapport quickly with senior professionals.
Organisation: You can prioritise effectively and stay on top of a large number of prospects, conversations and follow-ups.
Growth mindset: You actively seek feedback and continuously look for ways to improve your performance.
Winning mentality: Whether demonstrated through sales, academics, competitive sports, entrepreneurship or another environment, you have evidence of setting ambitious goals and pushing yourself to achieve them.
Previous sales experience is an advantage but not a requirement . We are equally interested in exceptional graduates and early-career candidates who can demonstrate the drive, communication skills and competitive mindset needed to build a successful career in sales.
Start date: Flexible.
Monday–Friday we work from our office next to Sloane Square Station. Due to the collaborative nature of our work, we do not offer remote work.

Field Sales Representative - Newcastle
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide.

From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.
We’re looking for a Field Sales Executive to join our Newcastle team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll help us build relationships with new restaurant partners across the region, improving our proposition for customers and identifying ways to continue our fast growth.
Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.
What You’ll Be Doing
You’ll be joining the Regional UK and Ireland team. The Regional UK and Ireland team drives Deliveroo's performance across all 4 nations of UKI. From Brighton, to Bognor to Belfast, we are experts in the local markets we serve, focusing on bringing the best possible selection to our customers and opportunities for growth to our partners.

s.h: Here’s what your day-to-day might look like
s.t:
Drive regional restaurant acquisition: Map, prospect, pitch, and close high-value restaurant partners across your region to expand our local market selection.
Execute strategic business development: Engage with independent restaurants via physical visits, emails, calls, and social platforms to demonstrate the commercial value of Deliveroo’s technology.
Own the commercial onboarding journey: Oversee the end-to-end partner onboarding process to ensure it is fast, efficient, and seamless for new partners.
Structure high-impact partnerships: Negotiate contract terms and partnership structures that secure win-win commercial outcomes for both restaurants and Deliveroo.
Act as a local territory expert: Develop deep insight into the regional food scene, mapping out up-and-coming culinary trends and identifying the key brands that local customers crave.
What You’ll Need to Thrive
Essential
Proven new business acquisition: Demonstrated sales experience with a track record of actively targeting new business and consistently delivering against demanding commercial targets.
Commercial negotiation skills: Strong commercial acumen with the ability to handle negotiations and structure profitable, sustainable deals.
Autonomy and field-based resilience: A self-motivated, tenacious approach with the ability to work independently and spend significant time out on the road meeting prospects.
Effective relationship building: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to connect with diverse business owners and present product value clearly.
Mobility requirement: Possession of a valid UK driving licence and access to a vehicle to facilitate travel across the North East and Yorkshire region.
Industry sector knowledge: Prior experience or a deep understanding of the economics of hospitality, food delivery, or high-growth marketplace operations.

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:
🔧 Make a visible impact every day Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.
🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.
🧠 Build a career, not just a role Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.
🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.
We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here .
Our Global Structure
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.
If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

Entwicklung von Integrationslösungen für Gebäudeautomation, Energiemonitoring und BMS\-Anbindungen

Aufbau und Pflege eines regionalen Partnernetzwerks, insbesondere im Bereich Systemintegratoren

Beratung und Unterstützung von Planern und Integratoren bei komplexen Applikationen und Systemfragen
· Schulungen \& Präsentationen:

· CRM\- \& Pipeline\-Management:
Strukturierte Dokumentation von Projekten, Verkaufschancen und Kundenaktivitäten
Dein Profil
· Technische Ausbildung \& Weiterbildung:
Elektrotechnische Berufsausbildung (EFZ) sowie Weiterbildung HF/FH in Gebäudeautomation, Elektrotechnik oder Smart Building

Zertifizierte KNX\-Ausbildung (zwingend) sowie mindestens 3\-5 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im KNX\-Umfeld

Fundierte Kenntnisse im Energiemonitoring (z.B. Wandler\- und Zählertechnik) sowie Erfahrung mit Modbus, BACnet oder DALI/DALI 2 und deren Integration in BMS

Professionelles Auftreten sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikations\- und Verhandlungsstärke im B2B\-Umfeld

Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Lösungen verständlich und überzeugend darzustellen (online und vor Ort)

Hohe Serviceorientierung und Freude an nachhaltiger Kundenbetreuung

Hohe Eigeninitiative, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Motivation, ein wachsendes Geschäftsfeld aktiv mitzugestalten

We’re looking for a Field Sales Executive, Mandarin Speaking to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.
What You’ll Be Doing
You’ll be joining the Chinese Category team. The Chinese Category team works alongside our entire UKI Commercial teams to drive Deliveroo’s performance across local markets, focusing on signing the best cuisine selection and expanding our footprint within this high-growth sector.

Drive regional restaurant acquisition: Map, prospect, pitch, and close high-value Chinese restaurant partners across London and surrounding territories to expand our local marketplace selection.
Execute strategic business development: Engage directly with independent restaurants in Mandarin or Cantonese via physical visits, phone calls, and social platforms to demonstrate the commercial value of Deliveroo’s technology.
Own the commercial onboarding journey: Oversee the end-to-end partner onboarding process to ensure it is fast, efficient, and seamless for new partners.
Secure early partner success: Actively support and monitor new restaurant performance within their first eight weeks on the platform to maximise their long-term growth.
Act as a local territory expert: Build deep insight into the regional Asian culinary scene, travelling across London and adjacent areas like Oxford, Cambridge, and Norwich to identify key brands that local customers crave.
What You’ll Need to Thrive
Essential
Language proficiency: Fluency in Chinese Mandarin with the ability to negotiate and build professional commercial partnerships.
Proven new business acquisition: Demonstrated sales experience with a track record of actively targeting new business and consistently delivering against demanding commercial targets.
Commercial negotiation skills: Strong commercial acumen with the ability to handle negotiations, understand marketplace economics, and structure profitable, sustainable deals.
Autonomy and field-based resilience: A self-motivated, tenacious approach with the ability to work independently and spend significant time out on the road meeting prospects.
Right to work: Valid and current right to work in the United Kingdom.

Additional language skills: Professional command or working knowledge of Cantonese.
Mobility requirement: Possession of a valid UK driving licence and access to a personal vehicle to facilitate travel across surrounding regions.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

At Jamf, we empower people to be their best selves and do their best work. Sales Development Representative is a key member of the sales team, responsible for help prospects understand how they can make the management of their Apple devices robust and easy.

You will be calling incoming leads, as well as develop your own leads through social media and phone. Once you have found a qualified opportunity, you will pass it on to the Inside or Field sales team. You will have a close working relationship with these teams, as well as with our Marketing teams.

As a member of the Jamf family, you will contribute to our high energy, collaborative and fun environment
This role is offered as remote in Japan. You may be required to work periodically at a Jamf office or collaborative work location with other Jamf employees in your area for certain events or moments that matter.

While the role is open to candidates based anywhere in Japan, candidates located in Tokyo (hybrid) or Fukuoka (remote) are preferred based on current team structure and collaboration needs. We are only able to accept applications from those who are legally authorized to live and work in Japan. #LI-Remote

Work closely with the extended Sales team and the Marketing team

## Office de la formation professionnelle | 70-80 % | Coire ##
L'Office de la formation professionnelle (OFP) est un service du Département de l'éducation, de la culture et de la protection de l'environnement (DEPE) et met en œuvre les mandats éducatifs de la Confédération et du canton dans le domaine de la formation professionnelle initiale. Il est également un centre de compétence pour les questions d'orientation professionnelle, scolaire et universitaire ainsi qu'une instance d'accompagnement tout au long de la carrière professionnelle.
Le département Orientation professionnelle, études et carrière (OPEC) conseille et informe personnellement, de manière indépendante et gratuite les jeunes et les adultes sur les questions de profession, d'études et de carrière. L'OPEC soutient dans le choix de la profession, des études ou de la carrière et accompagne dans la planification de l'avenir professionnel.
Nous recherchons pour l'Office de la formation professionnelle à partir du 1er janvier 2027 ou selon accord un/e conseiller/-ère en orientation professionnelle, études et carrière (70-80 %).
Votre domaine de responsabilités
* Conseil et information des jeunes et des adultes dans le choix de la profession, de l'école et des études ainsi que dans la conception de la carrière professionnelle
* Soutien des clients à utiliser leurs propres ressources, à agir de manière autonome et à prendre des décisions indépendantes
* Entretien de la collaboration avec les enseignants des niveaux secondaires I et II ainsi que des écoles secondaires supérieures et écoles professionnelles pour la préparation au choix de la profession et la conception de la carrière

Are you looking for an opportunity to grow your sales skills and make an impact in people’s lives? Join our award-winning Sales team that prides itself on culture, growth, and the ability to build lasting customer relationships.

We're a team of inclusive, diverse, and results-oriented problem solvers who have a direct impact on the company's success. Work from the comfort of your own home and assist customers in finding the products they need, such as internet, TV, phone, home security, and more. All calls at Clearlink are inbound, eliminating the need for cold calling.

Leads are generated by our fantastic in-house marketing teams and sent directly to you.
The Impact You Will Make
Represent Fortune 500 brands to assist customers in making informed purchasing choices, building important relationships, and expanding the value of their selections.
Apply a one-call sales approach, improving every interaction to increase your earnings.
Attend regular progress meetings with your expert coach to work towards personal goals that will drive success - and earnings!

s.t:
Proven growth mindset: We'll provide training on our sales processes and support your development of new and existing skills. We’re looking for someone who is open to learning and innovative approaches.
Exceptional communication skills: As you'll be interacting with people throughout the day on the phone, the ability to understand their needs is critical for closing sales.
Ability to work from home with access to a private workspace and reliable home internet.

✈️Generous Paid Holidays: Celebrate cultural diversity with additional flex holidays. Guaranteed 2 holidays off per year and time and a half pay for other observed holidays you may have to work.
🏠Remote Work Options: Embrace the flexibility of working from home.
🛟Comprehensive Life Insurance: Ensure peace of mind with coverage that extends beyond the workplace with employer paid life insurance (including coverage for dependents and spouses).
💵Annual Pay Increases: With our regular annual raises, you can anticipate a raise every year, based on your exceptional performance.

We are seeking a motivated and results-driven Solar Sales Development Representative (SDR) to join our Residential Solar team. This role is responsible for generating qualified homeowner appointments for Solar Account Managers through high-volume outbound/inbound prospecting and lead qualification.
The ideal candidate will play a critical role in driving top-of-funnel pipeline by engaging prospective customers, educating them on the benefits of residential solar, and scheduling qualified consultations. This position is focused on outbound calling, inbound lead management, follow-up communication, and appointment pipeline development. This role does not carry closing or full-cycle sales responsibilities and is focused exclusively on pipeline generation and appointment setting.
This role is full-time and offers competitive benefits, base salary + commission, and strong opportunities for career growth into full-cycle sales roles within a rapidly growing industry.

Generate and qualify leads for residential solar through high-volume outbound prospecting, including phone calls, email outreach, and SMS communication.
Engage with prospective customers to introduce residential solar solutions, assess initial interest, and determine qualification based on established criteria (homeownership, energy usage, and eligibility factors).
Schedule qualified appointments for Solar Account Managers, ensuring all required information is captured and accurately documented.
Execute structured follow-up efforts to confirm appointments, improve show rates, and maintain consistent multi-touch engagement with prospective customers.
Maintain accurate records of outreach activity, customer interactions, lead status, and pipeline progression within CRM systems.
Collaborate closely with Solar Account Managers to ensure high-quality appointment handoff and alignment on prospect expectations.
Consistently meet or exceed daily, weekly, and monthly activity and performance metrics, including call volume, contact rates, and appointments set.
Build interest and maintain engagement by utilizing strong communication and objection-handling skills when speaking with prospective customers.
Effectively manage time and prioritize outreach efforts to maintain a steady pipeline of qualified appointments.
Stay informed on residential solar offerings, basic industry concepts, and company value propositions to effectively communicate with prospective customers.
Occasional travel required for company sponsored training and events.

Strong verbal communication skills with the ability to quickly build rapport and engage customers over the phone.
Comfortable working in a high-volume outbound calling environment with activity-based performance expectations.
Detail-oriented with strong organizational and time management abilities.
Self-motivated and results-driven, with a demonstrated ability to meet or exceed performance goals.
Ability to manage multiple communication channels including outbound calls, email, and SMS.
Ability to handle objections, navigate customer concerns, and maintain professionalism in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (particularly Outlook and Excel) and CRM platforms.
Highly adaptable with the ability to respond effectively to feedback and process changes.

The SDR, Strategic Accounts is responsible for generating new business opportunities across both prospective and existing customer accounts. The role focuses on strategic account development, identifying high-value opportunities within complex organizations and creating meaningful engagement with the right stakeholders.
For prospective accounts , the SDR owns outbound prospecting efforts to identify and create new opportunities within high-priority strategic accounts. This includes researching accounts, identifying key stakeholders and buying groups, leveraging intent and account signals, and developing personalized outreach that creates meaningful sales conversations.
For customer accounts , the focus shifts toward expansion . The SDR partners closely with Account Directors and other customer-facing teams to identify whitespace, new teams or business units, additional use cases, and other signals that may indicate an opportunity for growth. The SDR helps create new relationships within existing customers and generates qualified expansion opportunities for the account team.
Across both motions, the SDR is expected to take an account-based approach rather than simply prospecting individual contacts. This means understanding the broader organization, mapping relevant stakeholders, identifying business priorities and potential use cases, and coordinating outreach across multiple personas where appropriate.
The role also supports strategic account planning by surfacing relevant insights, engagement signals, and prospect intelligence that can help Account Directors prioritize where to focus their efforts.

Create personalized, multi-channel prospecting campaigns tailored to the account and stakeholder.
Identify expansion opportunities within existing customers, including new teams, departments, business units, and use cases.
Partner with Account Directors on account strategy, whitespace identification, and coordinated outreach.
Generate qualified meetings and opportunities that align with the strategic account's potential and business priorities.
Maintain accurate account and contact intelligence in Salesforce and relevant sales development tools.
Provide Account Directors with actionable prospect intelligence, including organizational changes, initiatives, pain points, and relevant buying signals.
Contribute to strategic account plans and broader ABX initiatives across priority accounts.
